h: BBNaija's Mercedes reportedly appeals to Don Jazzy for help, says she is not chasing a lavish lifestyle
p: BBNaija's Mercedes has reportedly appealed to Don Jazzy for assistance while insisting she is not chasing a lavish lifestyle. The plea follows reports that the music executive recently announced a tech scholarship and gave out money.
more: Don Jazzy has not publicly responded so far.
Reactions online are split between sympathy and criticism.
